description: Evaluates whether tdk-specify correctly generates 9-section specs in default (full brainstorm with Option A/B) and --fast (single recommendation) modes.

evals.prompt: tdk-001 Add a user login feature. Users should be able to log in with email and password, see an error if credentials are wrong, and stay logged in after refreshing the page.
evals.expected_output: A spec.md file created at .specify/feature/tdk-001/spec.md with 9 numbered sections (Problem Statement, Scope Boundary, Impact Surface, Evaluated Approaches, User Requirements & Testing, Functional Requirements, Success Criteria, Risks & Mitigations, Unresolved Questions) plus a Clarifications section. Checklist at .specify/feature/tdk-001/checklists/requirements.md.
assertions: File .specify/feature/tdk-001/spec.md is created
spec.md contains '## 1. Problem Statement' section with concrete problem description
spec.md contains '## 2. Scope Boundary' with ≥1 in-scope and ≥1 out-of-scope item
spec.md contains '## 3. Impact Surface' with a table
spec.md contains '## 4. Evaluated Approaches' with Option A/B structure
spec.md contains '## 5. User Requirements & Testing' with at least 2 user requirements
Each user requirement contains at least one Given/When/Then acceptance scenario
User requirements contain [subworkspace/module] tags (if Impact Surface is non-empty)
spec.md contains '## 6. Functional Requirements' section
Functional requirements contain [subworkspace/module] tags (if Impact Surface is non-empty)
All functional requirements are testable and unambiguous (no vague terms like 'fast', 'easy')
spec.md contains '## 7. Success Criteria' with measurable criteria
Success criteria contain no implementation details (no mention of JWT, Redis, database, React, etc.)
spec.md contains '## 8. Risks & Mitigations' table
spec.md contains '## 9. Unresolved Questions' section
spec.md contains '## Clarifications' section at the end
spec.md does NOT contain inline [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers
spec.md does NOT mention implementation technologies (no Laravel, Vue, MySQL, API, etc.)
File .specify/feature/tdk-001/checklists/requirements.md is created

evals.prompt: tdk-002 thêm chức năng export báo cáo ứng viên ra file excel. Admin có thể chọn khoảng thời gian và lọc theo trạng thái ứng viên trước khi export.
evals.expected_output: A spec.md created at .specify/feature/tdk-002/spec.md with 9 sections. The spec must correctly interpret the Vietnamese input — user is an Admin, the feature is exporting candidate reports to Excel with date range filter and status filter. All unresolved questions in ## 9. Unresolved Questions, not inline markers.
assertions: File .specify/feature/tdk-002/spec.md is created
spec.md contains '## 1. Problem Statement' identifying the export need
spec.md contains '## 2. Scope Boundary' section
spec.md contains '## 3. Impact Surface' section
spec.md contains '## 5. User Requirements & Testing' correctly identifying Admin as actor
spec.md covers the primary flow: Admin selects filters → exports → downloads file
spec.md includes an acceptance scenario for empty results (no candidates match filters)
spec.md contains '## 6. Functional Requirements' section
spec.md contains '## 7. Success Criteria' section
Success criteria are technology-agnostic (no mention of xlsx library, S3, etc.)
spec.md contains '## 9. Unresolved Questions' section
spec.md contains '## Clarifications' section
spec.md does NOT contain inline [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers
spec.md does NOT contain implementation details
File .specify/feature/tdk-002/checklists/requirements.md is created

evals.expected_output: The skill should stop with a clear error message indicating that a feature description is required. No spec.md file should be created. Error message should include usage instructions.
assertions: No file .specify/feature/tdk-003/spec.md is created
Output contains an error message about missing description
Output includes usage example (e.g., '/tdk-specify tdk-003 "description"')

evals.prompt: tdk-004 Add user registration with API endpoint, database model, and signup page
evals.expected_output: A spec.md at .specify/feature/tdk-004/spec.md with Impact Surface covering both backend and frontend subworkspaces. User stories and FR tagged with [sw/module] tags distributed across backend/api, backend/models, frontend/pages.
assertions: File .specify/feature/tdk-004/spec.md is created
spec.md contains '## 3. Impact Surface' table with rows for both backend and frontend subworkspaces
Impact Surface table contains at least 2 distinct subworkspace names
spec.md contains '## 5. User Requirements & Testing' with [subworkspace/module] tags
User requirement tags reference both backend and frontend subworkspaces
spec.md contains '## 6. Functional Requirements' with [subworkspace/module] tags
FR tags distribute across backend/api, backend/models, and frontend/pages
Tags use lowercase/slash format only (e.g. [backend/api], not [Backend/API])
spec.md contains all 9 numbered sections
spec.md contains '## Clarifications' section
spec.md does NOT contain inline [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers
